and by which named test that can be found in the tree.
A category is either a named test that EXISTS in the package's own test files,
or a reason saying why the category does not apply. A blank is a finding for a
Tier A package and a counted gap for a Tier B or C package.
This file is the source of truth. `docs/qa-matrix.md` is GENERATED from it and
the gate fails when the two disagree.

SPA under `web/spa` -- is covered by its Vitest suite and by the `spa-coverage`
and `spa-e2e` gates, and it appears in the critical path below as a browser
spec rather than as a package.
